title: Ground-floor apartments fronting the street have separate pedestrian access
text: Addressing the street. C3.6.2 Ground floor apartments fronting the street are provided with separate pedestrian access from the street.
notes: diverges: new here (no ch3 twin; Chapter 3 C3.6.2 is the POS outlook, here C3.6.1-r1). Carried from Part C C3.6.4. Tested with building.ground_floor_apartments_separate_entry; answer true where no ground-floor apartment fronts the street (no fact flags that case).

verified.note: Wording confirmed. No fact flags the case where no ground-floor apartment fronts the street (answer true).
